summary.t: Plywood Christmas bauble, featuring mini hanging golden acrylic baubles with each family member's name and the family name laser-engraved.

text.t: A delicate plywood Christmas piece, decorated with personalised mini golden acrylic baubles featuring each family member's name and the family name laser-engraved, where every detail celebrates the beauty of the bonds that unite us.

options.people.help.t: More than 8? Contact us: we can make a larger ball so everyone fits.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is a decoration and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
